text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day near the end of June...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At Etsuko Otonashi's invitation, we<n>go to spectate
the Takarazuka<n>Kinen—the Grand Prix race of the
spring season.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners have entered the<n>backstretch, vying for
the mantle of<n>this year's Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is the fan favorite for<n>this race.
She's been on a winning<n>streak since her return
from Hong<n>Kong.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
However, she's up against the<n>previous
Umamusume of the Year, Air<n>Groove.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
This race will certainly be a turning<n>point in Silence
Suzuka's career.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's become a showdown between<n>the seemingly
unstoppable Silence<n>Suzuka, and Air Groove, the
Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Considering her achievements last<n>year, I came in
expecting Air Groove<n>to have the advantage, but...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is in the lead as the<n>runners enter
the final stretch!<n>However, Air Groove is quickly
closing in from the outside!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But in the end, it's Silence Suzuka!<n>Silence Suzuka
makes one final push<n>and crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! She crossed the finish line<n>without anybody
passin' her! Suzuka<n>sure knows how to run!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it... To think she was<n>powerful
enough to beat even<n>someone like Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Make no mistake—at this moment,<n>Silence Suzuka is
no less than a<n>top-class runner!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Combined with her undeniable talent,<n>Silence
Suzuka's victory over an<n>Umamusume of the Year
like Air<n>Groove is sure to leave a lasting<n>impression.
